name: The Vigilante Diaries
source:
After two tours of duty in the Vietnam War, a working-class man returns to his hometown, to face a city now ravaged by crime, corruption, and social inequality. In this situation, there is only one way out for a lonely and desperate man…

…taking justice into his own hands.

In “The Vigilante Diaries”, players will recap the life of a masked vigilante and define not only his appearance, but his rules, methods, and red lines: Will you be an chivalrous crimefighter or a fearsome and ruthless avenger? Will you prioritize protecting the innocent or will your crusade for justice come before everything and everyone? It's up to you to decide.

[From [url=https://www.thevigilantediaries.com/]official website[/url]]
translation:
在越南战争中两次服役后，一名工人阶级回到家乡，面对一座如今饱受犯罪、腐败和社会不平等蹂躏的城市。在这种情况下，对于一个孤独绝望的人来说，只有一条出路……

……将正义掌握在自己手中。

在《治安维持者日记》中，玩家将重温蒙面治安维持者的一生，不仅定义他的外表，还定义他的规则、方法和红线：你会成为一名侠义的犯罪斗士，还是一个可怕而无情的复仇者？你会优先考虑保护无辜者，还是将你的正义十字军放在一切和所有人之上？由你决定。

[来自[url=https://www.thevigilantediaries.com/]官方网站[/url]]
